notes: Reconciled from coders A and B. Disagreements were mostly: (1) phase for the ask-when-unsure rule (P10) and for informs statements, set to during-work and general; (2) actor all versus a named role; (3) unit_stance for disclosure duties, where 'require' was reserved for AI use itself being required; (4) near-miss types (P63 vs P70, P82 vs P02, P19 vs P32, UNCOVERED vs P102). Document stance differed only for the GenAI Guidelines (A permit, B delegates); final is permit because the guidelines encourage GenAI use with conditions for all users and defer only the coursework rule. Sample syllabus statements on the CTE pages (journalism, business, nursing, English HNRS 190, engineering ME 208) are coded as policies because they state concrete rules, but they are CTE examples and not KU-wide rules; the HNRS 190 sample is from an honors course, not computing. Several CTE samples repeat across the two CTE pages and are coded once per document. School and computing layers: none found; course layer deferred.
